facts.fact: The government's official site says the town hall digitalisation project (PDiMa) is in preparation and will soon be deployed, planning to connect 136 municipal buildings, which it gives as all the country's town halls; it states no town hall as connected yet (no event date given, dated to publication).

PDiMa is planned, not yet deployed: a state project that is to connect the 136 municipal buildings themselves, alongside 1,488 public schools and 253 health centres, the connected buildings then serving as anchor points for broadband to nearby households and firms (dated to publication).
The government's official site says PDiMa is financed by KfW Development Bank; no domestic budget line is stated (dated to publication).
Recruitment for PDiMa has been launched by the Ministère de l'efficacité du service public et de la transformation numérique, the ministry carrying the project (dated to publication).

As reported on 7 February 2026, PDiMa is in preparation with several recruitments launched by the ministry and deployment announced as coming soon; the article gives no date for the recruitments, so this is dated to publication.
